create_LARS_optimizer: create a LARS optimizer instance with custom learning rate, weight decay, momentum, and trust coefficient
run_LARS_step: run a single optimization step using the LARS optimizer to update model parameters
build_LARS_with_defaults: build a LARS optimizer using default momentum of 0.9 and trust coefficient of 0.001
review_LARS_step: review the LARS step method that applies adaptive local learning rate scaling for parameters with more than 1 dimension
refactor_LARS_weight_decay: refactor the LARS optimizer to customize weight decay behavior for normalization gamma, beta, or bias parameters
